decisions.reason: As a 2024 line extension in physical vinyl that builds on the core catalog, it is likely to be retained because management has already committed assortment space and public visibility to it and can still frame any weak early response as a temporary trial-phase issue, though the 'test' character makes it somewhat easier to discontinue than a flagship series.

This compilation series fits the firm's collector-focused physical-media strategy and likely carries stronger editorial and reputational commitment, so under escalation of commitment management would be inclined to continue it and attribute any initial underperformance to the normal ramp-up of a newly launched niche series in a growing market.
